summary: Frontend-only verification of effAmt() display fix for weight-based presets in PediDrip. Mobile viewport 430x900, weight=12 kg. All acceptance criteria pass: (1) On-screen summary sheet shows Epinefrin Sediaan '3,6 mg / 50 mL' (weight-based Rule of 0,6 = 0.3*12 = 3.6 mg) — no em-dash. (2) Regression: Midazolam summary Sediaan = '50 mg / 50 mL', Laju pump = '0,72 mL/jam'. (3) Print popup (Cetak) opens a NEW window with heading 'PediDrip — Lembar Terapi Infus Kontinu', column 'Bolus / muat (sekali beri)', Epinefrin Sediaan '3,6 mg / 50 mL'; no JS errors. (4) Regression: read-midazolam = '0,72'; theme-toggle click works without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: effAmt() correctly branches on preset.amtPerKg — computed from bb when weight-based, otherwise num(st.amt). Rounded to 3 decimals, which is appropriate.
SummarySheet.js line 42 and printHtml.js line 53 both use rapi(effAmt(d, st, bb)) — consistent between on-screen and printed sheets. Good.
isWeightBased() is exported but not used anywhere in components/printHtml; consider removing or wiring into DrugCard to visually indicate the amount field is auto-computed. Minor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: effAmt fix verified. Test flow: fill weight-input=12, click text='Epinefrin' to expand, click summary-toggle-epinefrin; click text='Midazolam' to expand, click summary-toggle-midazolam. Summary body text contains '3,6 mg / 50 mL' and '50 mg / 50 mL' and '0,72 mL/jam'. Print flow uses context.expect_page() to capture popup; popup HTML contains all expected strings. No console errors observed (only harmless RN-web 'pointerEvents deprecated' warning).
